entries.originalSemantics: Client-supplied verified=true and verificationResult.ok=true were accepted as a successful Run creation contract.
entries.historicalReason: Client input cannot be trusted server evidence.
entries.replacementAssertion: POST /api/runs rejects client-owned trust fields with CLIENT_SUPPLIED_TRUST_FIELD_FORBIDDEN; a legal Run remains verified=false and verificationResult=null.

entries.originalSemantics: Successful isolated verification promoted afterVerify.verified to true.
entries.historicalReason: Isolated evidence and business trust are distinct authorities.
entries.replacementAssertion: verification.ok and runEvidenceValidated may be true while businessVerified and run.verified remain false.

entries.originalSemantics: Missing evidence fails verification with missing_evidence and verified=false.
entries.historicalReason: Not historical; retained as an active security assertion.
entries.replacementAssertion: Missing evidence continues to produce missing_evidence and business verified=false.

entries.originalSemantics: Execution failure fails verification with execution_failed and verified=false.
entries.historicalReason: Not historical; retained as an active security assertion.
entries.replacementAssertion: Execution failure continues to produce execution_failed and business verified=false.

entries.originalSemantics: Task/run linkage and verified/verificationResult field presence were checked without an explicit no-promotion boundary.
entries.historicalReason: The shape/linkage contract remains active but needs an explicit trust-boundary assertion.
entries.replacementAssertion: Task/run linkage and field presence alone leave verified=false and verificationResult=null.
